product_summary: Website saanvicorp.com (fetched) describes Saanvi Corp as a Mumbai-based (C-2091 Oberoi Garden Estate, Chandivali Farm Road, Andheri East, Mumbai 400072) sourcing / marketing / contract-manufacturing house for speciality chemicals, founded 25 Aug 2017. Declared product lines on the site: Food & Nutrition (minerals, vitamins, premixes, preservatives, non-nutritional additives), Animal Feed (mineral supplements, feed additives — Calcium Propionate, Iron Salts, Sodium Benzoate), Pharmaceuticals (excipients, intermediates, lubricants, preservatives), Water Treatment, Personal Care/Home Care (oleochemicals, thickeners, stabilizers, preservatives, emollients), Agrochemicals, Mining. No downloadable catalogue or product-level spec sheets were reachable: /products/ returns 404 and /food-nutrition/ returns 404, so the product list is limited to the homepage category teasers and the Animal Feed page (which itself contains boilerplate Lorem Ipsum text and a copy-paste 'water treatment chemicals' sentence — a sign of a template site, not a verified catalogue).
comment: HS 2833.29 (other sulphates) is only PARTIALLY consistent. The only declared product that plausibly falls in 2833.29 is 'Iron Salts' (ferrous sulphate = 2833.29); the other two named products are outside that heading entirely: Calcium Propionate = 2915.50 and Sodium Benzoate = 2915.29. The declared single code 2833.29 therefore does not cover the company's actual line, which is dominated by organic acid salts/preservatives, feed additives (2309.90), vitamins/premixes (2936.29) and blended speciality formulations (3824.99). Per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground: company is retained, code corrected to the actual product mix, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a MISCLASSIFICATION: the site shows no oil, gas, petrochemical or hydrocarbon activity at all — it is a speciality/fine chemicals, food-feed-pharma ingredients and water-treatment trading house. Role: trader / marketing partner / contract-manufacturing outsourcer — the site explicitly says 'Sourcing Services', 'Marketing Partner', 'Solution Provider', 'Contract Manufacturing', with no plant, no manufacturing licence and no capacity data published; it presents itself as a channel between global manufacturers and Indian customers, so role_hint = trader (possibly manufacturer_trader if contract manufacturing is done at third-party sites, unverified). Product lines MISSING from the declaration: food & nutrition premixes and vitamins, pharmaceutical excipients/intermediates, personal-care oleochemicals and emollients, agrochemicals, mining chemicals, water-treatment formulations. All product claims are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line, invoice, B-L or GST-level product record was checked or found in this HS-only review; the site's own 'Exports to over 40 countries' claim is likewise unverified marketing text. Note also that the site's Animal Feed page carries placeholder Lorem Ipsum copy, so even the declared product list should be treated as indicative only. No PAN, CIN, GSTIN or IEC is published on the site — null, not public.
